V-M-AFK-SESSION.Scenario: success: createSession writes docs/afk-sessions/<id>/state.json with a correct expiresAt.
failure: Invalid hours or checkpoint values throw.
success: checkActive returns ok=true while fresh and expired after expiresAt.
success: markStopped sets status=stopped; findActiveSession returns null.
success: markCompleted makes the session not-active.

V-M-AFK-JOURNAL.Scenario: success: appendDecision writes a header and entry fields (class, title, context, rationale, outcome).
success: appendDeferred adds a single-line entry with timestamp and optional suggestion.

V-M-AFK-CONFIG.Scenario: success: loadAfkConfig returns null plus a descriptive error when no candidate exists at env, project, or global.
failure: loadAfkConfig returns null plus error on invalid JSON at the resolved path.
success: loadAfkConfig parses a valid project-local file and reports source=project.
success: loadAfkConfig falls back to ~/.grace/afk.json when no project-local override exists and reports source=global.
success: resolveAfkConfigPath picks $GRACE_AFK_CONFIG when it exists, overriding both project and global.
success: resolveAfkConfigPath ignores $GRACE_AFK_CONFIG when the referenced file is missing and falls through to the next candidate.
success: resolveAfkConfigPath prefers project-local over global when both exist.
success: getTelegram returns null if the config lacks either botToken or chatId; returns credentials when both are present.
success: getMaxEscalations defaults to 3, honors a configured value, and falls back on negative/non-finite values.

V-M-AFK-USAGE.Scenario: success: readUsage returns null when the cache file is missing.
failure: readUsage returns null when the cache JSON is malformed.
success: readUsage parses five_hour / seven_day / extra_usage into a UsageSnapshot.
success: readUsage maps used_credits (cents) to dollars with two-decimal precision.
success: renderUsageLine formats "5h N% · 7d N% · $used/limit · cache age Xs".
success: renderUsageLine falls back to a readable message when the snapshot is null.

V-M-AFK-TELEGRAM.Scenario: success: sendMessage posts to /sendMessage and returns a messageId.
failure: sendMessage returns ok=false with the error description from the API.
success: fetchUpdates filters replies by chatId.
success: matchReply matches by reply_to_message_id or correlation id prefix.
success: classifyAnswer recognizes A-E, PROCEED, STOP, EVOLVE, DEFER in any token position.
success: classifyAnswer returns UNKNOWN with recognized=false for free-form text.
